::: {#sol-linear-param-grad}

Entry $j$ of the output is $z_j = \sum_k W_{jk} h_k + b_j$,
so $W_{jk}$ affects $L$ only through $z_j$.

$$
\begin{aligned}
\derivf{L}{W_{jk}}
&= \derivf{L}{z_j} \derivf{z_j}{W_{jk}}
&& \text{(chain rule through $z_j$)} \\
&= g_j h_k
&& \text{($\partial z_j / \partial W_{jk} = h_k$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

and in the same way $\partial L / \partial b_j = g_j \cdot 1 = g_j$.
As matrices,

$$
\gradwrt{\matr{W}} L = \underbrace{\vecf{g}}_{m \times 1} \, \underbrace{\tp{\vhidval}}_{1 \times n},
\qquad
\gradwrt{\vecf{b}} L = \vecf{g},
$$

for a layer with $n$ inputs and $m$ outputs:
an outer product with the same shape as $\matr{W}$.

:::
